datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule (January, April, July, October 2012) across Malawi administrative units. The data represents spatial projections of acute food insecurity phases under different scenarios, standardized using the IPC classification scale and aggregated by geographic area.
